name: Thalassic Fury
description: The plentiful waters serve as a cradle and a grave, merciful and merciless in equal measure.
effect: Followers of Kyogre may call upon 'Thalassic Fury' once per quest as a bonus action during their combat turn, allowing them to summon a swirling storm of water around a target, dealing their Rank Bonus as damage dice to the target at the end of the round for the next four rounds. While a foe is suffering this effect, they take 2 damage whenever they dodge. This damage ignores defenses. At Paragon, they gain a second use of this boon. Gain an extra charge at High Priest(ess). A target can only be affected by one instance of Kyogre or Groudon's boon at a time unless otherwise stated by a GM.
